lines:
Narrow UI edit commands for C4 element facts, relationship facts, and simple relationship creation.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Add narrow Tauri commands and dashboard models for listing/opening/creating/updating/deleting/importing Markdown design documents and editing their associations through ProjectStore and the shared transaction boundary. Reuse canonical snapshot readTokens rather than a separate UI-only version scheme. Support coherent title/body/link edits, explicit reference detachment and backend conflict errors. No desktop command writes generated Markdown as authoritative content or opens raw driver connections. Cross-client updates refresh clean content while preserving dirty drafts; stale saves surface the current canonical document for user reconciliation. Trigger/report derived output refresh after canonical commits without misreporting commit success.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.
